title: A preference for local interaction between layers emerges during training
abstract: arXiv:2611.27258v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A deep neural network is a stack of layers, and all layers are trained to lower one shared error. A change in one layer can therefore reach every other layer. Because the error is shared by all layers, one would expect the other layers to respond alike, whether they are next to the changed layer or far from it. We find that early in training the response is weak and its order by distance is not stable. As training proceeds, the response grows, and neighboring layers come to respond to changes in each other more strongly than layers further apart, in almost every network. This locality forms during training, although training links every layer to every other. We show this by pushing one layer of a copy of the network at many stages of training and measuring how much of the push reaches each of the other layers. The experiments use 512 five-layer networks trained on modular addition with each of two optimizers, AdamW and stochastic gradien

translated_title: 训练过程中层间局部相互作用偏好的自发形成
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络由多层堆叠而成，所有层都被训练以降低同一个共享误差。因此，某一层的变化可以传递到其他每一层。由于误差由所有层共享，人们会预期其他层的响应是相似的，无论它们紧邻被改变的层还是远离它。我们发现，在训练早期，这种响应很弱，且其按距离排序并不稳定。随着训练的进行，响应不断增强，并且在几乎每一个网络中，相邻层对彼此变化的响应都比距离更远的层更强。这种局部性在训练过程中形成，尽管训练本身通过共享误差将每一层与所有其他层连接起来。我们通过在训练的多个阶段推动网络副本中的一层，并测量这种推动有多少传递到其他每一层来展示这一现象。实验使用了512个五层网络，在模加法任务上分别使用AdamW和随机梯度下降两种优化器进行训练。
tldr: 该研究发现深度神经网络在训练过程中会自发形成“局部性”——相邻层之间对彼此变化的响应随训练不断增强，逐渐超过距离更远的层，尽管训练本身通过共享误差将所有层耦合在一起。
en_tdlr: The study reveals that a preference for local interaction emerges spontaneously during training in deep neural networks—neighboring layers respond increasingly more strongly to each other's changes than distant layers, even though training couples all layers through a shared error.
